build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions for graph transducer networks
build_cmake_extension: build a cmake extension module for gtn with automatic c++ compilation and linking
configure_cmake_build: configure the cmake build system with python bindings enabled and tests disabled
validate_cmake_version: validate that cmake version 3.5.1 or higher is installed before building gtn
load_readme_description: load the readme markdown file to use as the long description for the gtn package
